BIRD_DAY_COUNTS_MISSING.title: An opening or closing bird count is missing
BIRD_DAY_COUNTS_MISSING.destinationContext: Complete the bird counts for the affected flock and date.
BIRD_DAY_COUNTS_MISSING.verification: The system will check that both counts are present and that the bird movement equation can be calculated.
BIRD_DAY_COUNTS_MISSING.explanation: Complete the bird counts for the affected flock and date.
BIRD_DAY_COUNTS_MISSING.cause0: The Daily Record was saved before the physical count was completed.
BIRD_DAY_COUNTS_MISSING.cause1: A locked day needs a correction request.

BIRD_DAY_IMBALANCE.title: The daily bird count does not balance
BIRD_DAY_IMBALANCE.destinationContext: Compare movements and losses with the closing physical count.
BIRD_DAY_IMBALANCE.verification: The check clears only when opening birds plus arrivals minus every recorded loss and departure equals closing birds.
BIRD_DAY_IMBALANCE.explanation: Compare movements and losses with the closing physical count.
BIRD_DAY_IMBALANCE.cause0: A death, cull, transfer, or other removal is missing.
BIRD_DAY_IMBALANCE.cause1: The opening or closing physical count was entered incorrectly.

EGG_CLASSIFICATION_MISMATCH.title: The egg quality totals do not equal the eggs collected
EGG_CLASSIFICATION_MISMATCH.destinationContext: Recount the egg categories against the total collected.
EGG_CLASSIFICATION_MISMATCH.verification: The system will add all egg-quality categories and compare the result with total eggs collected.
EGG_CLASSIFICATION_MISMATCH.explanation: Recount the egg categories against the total collected.
EGG_CLASSIFICATION_MISMATCH.cause0: Normal, broken, or dirty eggs were counted incorrectly.
EGG_CLASSIFICATION_MISMATCH.cause1: The total collection was entered before classification finished.

MORTALITY_ALLOCATION_MISMATCH.title: The death total and recorded causes do not match
MORTALITY_ALLOCATION_MISMATCH.destinationContext: Match every recorded death to a cause or documented unexplained remainder.
MORTALITY_ALLOCATION_MISMATCH.verification: The finding clears when mortality cause events equal the official Daily Record death count.
MORTALITY_ALLOCATION_MISMATCH.explanation: Match every recorded death to a cause or documented unexplained remainder.
MORTALITY_ALLOCATION_MISMATCH.cause0: A mortality cause has not been recorded.
MORTALITY_ALLOCATION_MISMATCH.cause1: A cause event contains more birds than the official Daily Record death total.

LOCKED_RECORD_CHANGED_WITHOUT_APPROVAL.title: A locked Daily Record changed without approval
LOCKED_RECORD_CHANGED_WITHOUT_APPROVAL.destinationContext: Inspect the exact locked Daily Record and its governed correction history.
LOCKED_RECORD_CHANGED_WITHOUT_APPROVAL.verification: A CEO-approved correction must reference the changed source record.
LOCKED_RECORD_CHANGED_WITHOUT_APPROVAL.explanation: Inspect the exact locked Daily Record and its governed correction history.
LOCKED_RECORD_CHANGED_WITHOUT_APPROVAL.cause0: A correction bypassed the governed request process.
LOCKED_RECORD_CHANGED_WITHOUT_APPROVAL.cause1: An approved correction exists but was not linked to this record.

BIRD_DAY_CONTINUITY_BREAK.title: One day’s closing bird count does not match the next opening count
BIRD_DAY_CONTINUITY_BREAK.destinationContext: Review the consecutive dates and record the missing movement or correction.
BIRD_DAY_CONTINUITY_BREAK.verification: The next day must open with the same number of birds recorded at the previous close.
BIRD_DAY_CONTINUITY_BREAK.explanation: Review the consecutive dates and record the missing movement or correction.
BIRD_DAY_CONTINUITY_BREAK.cause0: A transfer or loss occurred between records but was not entered.
BIRD_DAY_CONTINUITY_BREAK.cause1: One of the two physical counts is incorrect.

FLOCK_CURRENT_COUNT_MISMATCH.title: The flock population does not match its latest Daily Record
FLOCK_CURRENT_COUNT_MISMATCH.destinationContext: Compare the flock population with the latest approved close.
FLOCK_CURRENT_COUNT_MISMATCH.verification: The flock profile and latest closing bird count must agree.
FLOCK_CURRENT_COUNT_MISMATCH.explanation: Compare the flock population with the latest approved close.
FLOCK_CURRENT_COUNT_MISMATCH.cause0: The flock master count was changed separately.
FLOCK_CURRENT_COUNT_MISMATCH.cause1: A recent Daily Record or lifecycle movement is incomplete.

FEED_SESSION_CLOSE_MISMATCH.title: Feeding sessions do not equal the closed feed total
FEED_SESSION_CLOSE_MISMATCH.destinationContext: Reopen the feeding day, verify its sessions, and close it again.
FEED_SESSION_CLOSE_MISMATCH.verification: Completed feeding sessions must add up to the closed daily feed total.
FEED_SESSION_CLOSE_MISMATCH.explanation: Reopen the feeding day, verify its sessions, and close it again.
FEED_SESSION_CLOSE_MISMATCH.cause0: A feeding session is missing or duplicated.
FEED_SESSION_CLOSE_MISMATCH.cause1: The feeding day was closed before all sessions were completed.

FEED_DAILY_SYNC_MISMATCH.title: Feed Control and the Daily Record do not agree
FEED_DAILY_SYNC_MISMATCH.destinationContext: Reopen and reclose the day so Feed Control synchronizes the Daily Record.
FEED_DAILY_SYNC_MISMATCH.verification: The Feed Control close and its synchronized Daily Record total must agree.
FEED_DAILY_SYNC_MISMATCH.explanation: Reopen and reclose the day so Feed Control synchronizes the Daily Record.
FEED_DAILY_SYNC_MISMATCH.cause0: The feeding day did not synchronize correctly.
FEED_DAILY_SYNC_MISMATCH.cause1: A legacy or manual feed value conflicts with Feed Control.

FEED_STOCK_ISSUE_MISMATCH.title: Feed used does not match the inventory deduction
FEED_STOCK_ISSUE_MISMATCH.destinationContext: Check the feeding close first, then inspect the linked inventory movement.
FEED_STOCK_ISSUE_MISMATCH.verification: Feed Control and its canonical inventory deduction must contain the same quantity.
FEED_STOCK_ISSUE_MISMATCH.explanation: Check the feeding close first, then inspect the linked inventory movement.
FEED_STOCK_ISSUE_MISMATCH.cause0: The feeding day did not post its stock issue correctly.
FEED_STOCK_ISSUE_MISMATCH.cause1: A duplicate or missing inventory movement exists.

EGG_SALE_UNLINKED.title: An egg sale is not linked to the flock that produced it
EGG_SALE_UNLINKED.destinationContext: Link the sale to its producing flock or document the approved allocation.
EGG_SALE_UNLINKED.verification: The sale must have a traceable production source.
EGG_SALE_UNLINKED.explanation: Link the sale to its producing flock or document the approved allocation.
EGG_SALE_UNLINKED.cause0: The flock was omitted when recording the sale.
EGG_SALE_UNLINKED.cause1: Eggs from multiple flocks need a documented allocation.

EGG_SALE_UNIT_UNCONVERTED.title: The sales unit cannot be converted into eggs
EGG_SALE_UNIT_UNCONVERTED.destinationContext: Correct the unit or configure its approved egg conversion.
EGG_SALE_UNIT_UNCONVERTED.verification: The system must be able to convert the sale quantity into individual eggs.
EGG_SALE_UNIT_UNCONVERTED.explanation: Correct the unit or configure its approved egg conversion.
EGG_SALE_UNIT_UNCONVERTED.cause0: A new sales unit was entered without an approved conversion.
EGG_SALE_UNIT_UNCONVERTED.cause1: The sale used an inconsistent unit name.

EGG_OPENING_BALANCE_UNAVAILABLE.title: The flock’s opening egg balance is unknown
EGG_OPENING_BALANCE_UNAVAILABLE.destinationContext: Create the missing placement-date record or request a governed legacy opening balance.
EGG_OPENING_BALANCE_UNAVAILABLE.verification: Production and sales custody must begin from a supported opening balance.
EGG_OPENING_BALANCE_UNAVAILABLE.explanation: Create the missing placement-date record or request a governed legacy opening balance.
EGG_OPENING_BALANCE_UNAVAILABLE.cause0: Production records began after the flock was placed.
EGG_OPENING_BALANCE_UNAVAILABLE.cause1: Opening egg stock was never documented.

EGG_SALES_EXCEED_PRODUCTION.title: Recorded egg sales exceed traceable production
EGG_SALES_EXCEED_PRODUCTION.destinationContext: Review the sales, units, flock links, and missing production records.
EGG_SALES_EXCEED_PRODUCTION.verification: Traceable marketable eggs plus supported opening stock must cover recorded egg sales.
EGG_SALES_EXCEED_PRODUCTION.explanation: Review the sales, units, flock links, and missing production records.
EGG_SALES_EXCEED_PRODUCTION.cause0: A sale is duplicated or uses the wrong unit.
EGG_SALES_EXCEED_PRODUCTION.cause1: Production or opening egg stock is missing.
EGG_SALES_EXCEED_PRODUCTION.cause2: A sale is linked to the wrong flock.

PHYSICAL_STOCK_VARIANCE.title: The physical stock count differs from the system balance
PHYSICAL_STOCK_VARIANCE.destinationContext: Recount the item and compare receipts, issues, transfers, and adjustments.
PHYSICAL_STOCK_VARIANCE.verification: A confirmed adjustment or corrected movement must bring physical and ledger stock into agreement.
PHYSICAL_STOCK_VARIANCE.explanation: Recount the item and compare receipts, issues, transfers, and adjustments.
PHYSICAL_STOCK_VARIANCE.cause0: A receipt, issue, transfer, or loss is missing.
PHYSICAL_STOCK_VARIANCE.cause1: The physical count or unit of measure is incorrect.

REPEATED_STOCK_ADJUSTMENTS.title: This stock item has been adjusted repeatedly
REPEATED_STOCK_ADJUSTMENTS.destinationContext: Compare the adjustments with source documents and recent physical counts.
REPEATED_STOCK_ADJUSTMENTS.verification: Future movements should use their correct transaction types and unexplained adjustments should stop recurring.
REPEATED_STOCK_ADJUSTMENTS.explanation: Compare the adjustments with source documents and recent physical counts.
REPEATED_STOCK_ADJUSTMENTS.cause0: Routine movements are being recorded as adjustments.
REPEATED_STOCK_ADJUSTMENTS.cause1: Counting, custody, or unit-conversion problems are recurring.

COST_ALLOCATION_MISMATCH.title: A recorded cost has not been fully assigned
COST_ALLOCATION_MISMATCH.destinationContext: Assign the full expense to the correct operating scope, or request a CEO exception.
COST_ALLOCATION_MISMATCH.verification: The allocation total must equal the recorded expense exactly, unless the CEO accepts a documented exception.
COST_ALLOCATION_MISMATCH.explanation: The expense exists, but all or part of it is not assigned to the farm, flock, or batch that should carry the cost.
COST_ALLOCATION_MISMATCH.cause0: The cost scope was left blank.
COST_ALLOCATION_MISMATCH.cause1: Allocation percentages or amounts do not total the expense.
COST_ALLOCATION_MISMATCH.cause2: The expense is genuinely organization-wide and needs a CEO exception.

LOCKED_FINANCIAL_PERIOD_HAS_GAPS.title: A locked financial period still contains unsupported costs
LOCKED_FINANCIAL_PERIOD_HAS_GAPS.destinationContext: Inspect the warnings and submit a governed correction where required.
LOCKED_FINANCIAL_PERIOD_HAS_GAPS.verification: The corrected period must contain no unexplained allocation gaps.
LOCKED_FINANCIAL_PERIOD_HAS_GAPS.explanation: Inspect the warnings and submit a governed correction where required.
LOCKED_FINANCIAL_PERIOD_HAS_GAPS.cause0: The period was locked before all costs were assigned.
LOCKED_FINANCIAL_PERIOD_HAS_GAPS.cause1: A warning was accepted without complete supporting evidence.

PAST_FINANCIAL_PERIOD_UNLOCKED.title: A past financial period is still open to changes
PAST_FINANCIAL_PERIOD_UNLOCKED.destinationContext: Finish cost review and have the CEO lock the period.
PAST_FINANCIAL_PERIOD_UNLOCKED.verification: The period must pass its checks and be locked by the CEO.
PAST_FINANCIAL_PERIOD_UNLOCKED.explanation: Finish cost review and have the CEO lock the period.
PAST_FINANCIAL_PERIOD_UNLOCKED.cause1: Unresolved costs or warnings prevented the period from being locked.

ACTIVE_FLOCK_LINEAGE_BROKEN.title: An active flock’s farm, house, and batch history do not agree
ACTIVE_FLOCK_LINEAGE_BROKEN.destinationContext: Stop lifecycle changes and submit a governed lineage correction.
ACTIVE_FLOCK_LINEAGE_BROKEN.verification: The flock, batch, house, and farm must form one consistent custody chain.
ACTIVE_FLOCK_LINEAGE_BROKEN.explanation: Stop lifecycle changes and submit a governed lineage correction.
ACTIVE_FLOCK_LINEAGE_BROKEN.cause0: The flock or batch was moved without completing the lifecycle workflow.
ACTIVE_FLOCK_LINEAGE_BROKEN.cause1: Farm or house ownership was changed independently.

BATCH_FLOCK_PLACEMENT_MISMATCH.title: The batch bird total does not equal its flock placements
BATCH_FLOCK_PLACEMENT_MISMATCH.destinationContext: Compare the original batch total with every linked flock placement.
BATCH_FLOCK_PLACEMENT_MISMATCH.verification: All linked flock placements must add up to the batch bird total.
BATCH_FLOCK_PLACEMENT_MISMATCH.explanation: Compare the original batch total with every linked flock placement.
BATCH_FLOCK_PLACEMENT_MISMATCH.cause0: A flock placement is missing or duplicated.
BATCH_FLOCK_PLACEMENT_MISMATCH.cause1: The batch count changed without updating its flock split.

POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_SALE.title: Two or more sales appear to be duplicates
POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_SALE.destinationContext: Confirm separate documents or void the duplicate through governance.
POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_SALE.verification: Every retained sale must have distinct, supportable source evidence.
POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_SALE.explanation: Confirm separate documents or void the duplicate through governance.
POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_SALE.cause0: The same sale was entered more than once.
POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_SALE.cause1: Separate sales share identical details but need different source references.

notices.production: Egg results apply to laying flocks. Growth targets use the bird’s age at measurement; missing targets and stale weights limit comparisons.
notices.feeding: Plans come from recorded sessions, not an assumed number of daily feedings. Lower feed alone does not mean better performance.
notices.health: Deaths and culls are separate. Recorded causes and treatments are evidence, not an automatic diagnosis.
notices.stock: Balances belong to whole warehouses, not a house or flock. Opening and period-end balances follow selected dates; current balances are as of refresh. Values use current prices and are estimates.
notices.salesCosts: Collections are amounts paid against the selected sales, not cash received during these dates. Profit estimates are not reconciled accounting results.
notices.overview: Changes describe the previous equal-length period. Direction alone is not a judgment of good or bad performance.

explanations.DAILY_LOSSES_NOT_SUPPORTING_EVENTS: Daily records supply loss totals; supporting events are not counted twice.
explanations.REPORT_LOAD_FAILED: One source failed to load. No zero result has been substituted.
explanations.CURRENT_PRICE_ESTIMATE: Stock value uses current item prices, not historical accounting valuation.
explanations.COLLECTIONS_AGAINST_SELECTED_SALES: Collections belong to the selected sales, regardless of payment date.
explanations.ESTIMATED_MARGIN: Margin is an estimate and may exclude costs not represented in its basis.
explanations.RECONCILED_MARGIN: Margin uses the available reconciled cost basis.
explanations.RECORDED_SESSION_PLAN_ONLY: Plans cover recorded feeding sessions only; no missing plan is invented.
explanations.INCOMPLETE_FEED_DAYS: Check closed-day coverage before treating feeding totals as complete.
explanations.GROWTH_FCR_ONLY: Growth conversion requires compatible weights, feed and population evidence.
explanations.AMBIGUOUS_MOVEMENT_DAY_EXCLUDED: Evidence without a clear location on a transfer date was excluded.
